title: Formal completion morphisms as compatible infinitesimal restriction families
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a finite type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For $n\geq0$ put $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ [def-pc-base-change], and let $j_n:X_n\to X$ and $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ be the canonical maps, with $i_n$ specified by both projections. Write $c_n:i_n^*j_{n+1}^*\cong j_n^*$ for the canonical tensor-pullback comparison induced by $i_nj_{n+1}=j_n$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $F,G$ be coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent] and set $K=I\mathcal O_X$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. There exists an equivalence of sets from the natural transformations between the formal completion inverse systems $(G/K^{n+1}G)_n$ and $(F/K^{n+1}F)_n$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] to the set of families $v_n:j_n^*G\to j_n^*F$ satisfying $v_n\circ c_{n,G}=c_{n,F}\circ i_n^*v_{n+1}$ for every $n\geq0$. For each $w:G\to F$ the equivalence takes the induced morphism of quotient systems to $(j_n^*w)_n$. This identifies two formal Hom sets and asserts no lifting to $\operatorname{Hom}_X(G,F)$.

proof.text: Apply thickeningSystems_dictionary with chosen tensor-pullback adjunctions to obtain hX, closed immersions j_n, the functors Φ and R, evaluation isomorphisms r, and ρ. Retain its bijection hb on morphisms and its completion-map equation hm.
Apply thickeningSystem_hom_transport to R,r and the comparison equation hr, with the dictionary comparisons d and the specified comparisons c. Obtain eR and its equation on R.map w.

Define the set equivalence b from system Hom to completion Hom by Equiv.ofBijective using hb. The equivalence q forgets the full-subcategory arrow wrapper, with inverse ObjectProperty.homMk. Compose q.symm, b.symm and eR. For a module map w use hm to identify b(R.map w) with completion.map w, the definitional equality q.symm(formalCompletionMap w)=completion.map w, and the inverse law of b. Finish with the equation heR.

    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
      pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))))
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I :=
      I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (c : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ≅
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c n = (Classical.choice (Scheme.Modules.nonempty_tensorPullbackComp (i n)
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 +
      1)))))))).symm ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (hi n)))
    (F G : X.Modules)
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G) :
    ∃ e : (formalCompletionSystem ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f) G ⟶
      formalCompletionSystem ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f) F) ≃
        {v : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj G ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj F |
          ∀ n : ℕ, (c n).hom.app G ≫ v n =
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map (v (n + 1)) ≫ (c n).hom.app F},
      ∀ w : G ⟶ F,
        e (formalCompletionMap ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f) w) =
          ⟨fun n ↦ (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).map w,
            fun n ↦ ((c n).hom.naturality w).symm⟩
